task: FV2-020 — Flutter Design V2 connected voice dock Mac visual acceptance
summary: Verified the connected VoiceDock presentation in the already-running Mac client and closed FV2-020 after the Android and Mac visual checks.

checks.name: Mac connected VoiceDock visual acceptance
checks.command: Use the already-running BOOHTACORD Mac client; join Voice as listener, capture the connected state, then leave
checks.observation: Screenshot showed the persistent bottom-left dock with green headset icon, ‘Голос подключён’, ‘Voice · 3 участника’, green connection bars and 7 ms ping. The microphone control was muted/red and the participant card stated ‘Микрофон выключен’. No screen share was started. The app was not relaunched; after the screenshot the client returned to the prejoin view with the local participant removed.

checks.name: Focused voice shortcut and VoiceDock regressions
checks.command: cd clients/flutter && flutter test --no-pub test/voice_shortcut_test.dart && flutter test --no-pub test/workspace_screen_test.dart --plain-name 'voice dock announces reconnect and deafen transition states'
checks.observation: Three shortcut modifier tests and the focused connected/reconnect/deafen VoiceDock test passed.

checks.name: Changed-file analyzer
checks.command: cd clients/flutter && dart analyze lib/src/features/voice/microphone/shortcut.dart lib/src/screens/auth_screen.dart lib/src/screens/workspace_screen.dart test/auth_screen_test.dart test/auth_typography_v2_test.dart test/voice_shortcut_test.dart

checks.name: Android API 35 emulator visual acceptance
checks.command: See QA-259 Android API 35 emulator check
checks.observation: The Android dock displayed the headset, connected status, participant count and live ping with the microphone muted; the temporary voice session was ended.

checks.name: Spec traceability verifier
checks.observation: PowerShell Core is not installed on this macOS host. No requirements or API contracts changed.

limitations: The Mac screenshot was inspected in-session and was not saved as a repository artifact.
The Android release referenced by QA-259 is a local test artifact and was not published by this follow-up.
